Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner ignored evidence that Jordan Pruitt was not a co-writer (Genius listed other writers) and incorrectly treated her as a co-writer/recording artist. They also conflated a publishing company (Walt Disney Music Company) with a record label and finalized the wrong label, overlooking the clear alternative indicated in results (Jordan Rudess’s “Permission to Fly” on InsideOut Music).
